newsitem.title: USA: Enron, Portland General set meetings.
newsitem.headline: Enron, Portland General set meetings.

text.p: Enron Corp and Portland General Corp said on Friday that their shareholder meetings to approve Enron's $2.1 billion stock swap acquisition of Portland General will be held November 12, 1996.
Proxy materials for the special meetings are being mailed to shareholders on October 11, the companies said in a joint statement.

Also, the companies' respective rights to terminate the merger will expire after the shareholder meetings, the companies said. Enron has the right to terminate the deal if its stock's closing price is more than $47.25 for a 20 trading day period that ends five trading days before the meeting.
Portland General has the right to terminate the deal if Enron's shares close below $36.25 during the same period, the companies said.
